5 تأكلّ : see 1, latter part, in two places: ―
-b2- and see also 8. ―
-b3- Also, said of a sword, (S, K,) and of silver (K, TA) molten, (TA,) and of lightning, and of collyrium, and of aloes, (K,) and of anything shiny, (TA,) (tropical:) It shone, gleamed, or glistened, (S, K, TA,) much, or intensely; (K;) when said of a sword, by reason of its sharpness. (S, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
